technical.summary: IQV shows strong short-term momentum with volume spike and bullish candlestick pattern, but lacks intermediate trend confirmation and trades below key moving averages, limiting swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: IQV shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 55 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (11/100) combined with recent large congressional purchase ($250k-$500k by Kurt Schrader in Jan) presents contrarian buy opportunity, though conviction weakened by lack of recent congressional activity and unavailable news sentiment.

risk.summary: Severe VIX crisis regime (359.36) combined with flat yield curve and negative macro score (-3) creates highly unfavourable conditions; earnings in 55 days adds moderate event risk but is not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Volume spike (15x), three white soldiers pattern, and extreme fear sentiment (11/100) with recent congressional accumulation ($250k-$500k) create a contrarian entry opportunity near support at 204.69.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trades below both SMA-200 and EMA-200, lacks intermediate trend confirmation (weak ADX 22.88, negative AO, overbought StochRSI), sits in crisis VIX regime (359.36), and faces high earnings risk in 55 days with zero fundamental catalysts or smart money alignment.

decision.entry_rationale: Volume spike and three white soldiers pattern offer short-term momentum, but price remains trapped below both SMA-200 and EMA-200 with weak intermediate trend confirmation (ADX 22.88, negative AO). Contrarian fear sentiment is offset by zero fundamental catalysts and crisis VIX regime.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (359.36) combined with earnings event in 55 days and lack of smart money accumulation creates asymmetric downside risk; price below key moving averages limits swing trade safety.
